name: FolkX
description: folkX is Folk's Chrome extension for capturing people and companies from LinkedIn, Sales Navigator, Gmail, Google Meet, social networks, and other websites into a Folk CRM workspace. It lets Folk users choose a workspace and group, enrich contact details, add notes and reminders, and work with CRM context while browsing.
agentUseSummary: Do not create a separate FolkX connection or install. Connect the canonical folk CRM provider for supported bounded CRM reads and approved management; Relay does not operate the folkX browser extension, borrow browser sessions, or scrape third-party social and web pages.

blocked.label: Create a separate folkX connection
blocked.description: folkX adds captured data to a selected Folk CRM workspace and group; it does not define a separate account, API authority, credential, or connection lifecycle.

blocked.label: Use a browser session
blocked.description: Relay does not install or operate the Chrome extension, borrow Folk or third-party session cookies, automate browser pages, or access private extension interfaces.

blocked.label: Capture data from social and web pages
blocked.description: Relay does not scrape, enrich, bulk import, or synchronize LinkedIn, Sales Navigator, Gmail, Google Meet, social-network, or arbitrary website data through this alias.

blocked.label: Run separate folkX agent actions
blocked.description: Supported CRM execution belongs to the canonical folk CRM provider, its exact API-key connection, bounded typed tools, and selected Safe or Dangerously skip permissions profile.

approvalProfiles.label: Use folk CRM
approvalProfiles.description: No separate folkX actions are enabled because folkX is Folk's browser extension for the same CRM workspace rather than an independent provider authority.

runtimeSupport.description: No duplicate folkX tools are mounted. OpenClaw uses the canonical folk CRM provider for supported bounded CRM actions.
No duplicate folkX tools are mounted. Hermes uses the canonical folk CRM provider for supported bounded CRM actions.

providerSetup.blocker: folkX is Folk's Chrome extension and writes captured contacts into an existing Folk CRM workspace and group. Publishing or connecting it separately would duplicate provider identity and CRM authority, while mounting the extension would require prohibited browser sessions and undocumented extension interfaces.
providerSetup.nextAction: Keep this product-extension slug non-installable and direct supported setup, connection, installation, and CRM execution to the canonical folk CRM provider. Customers may use folkX themselves inside Chrome for provider-owned capture workflows; revisit Relay support only if Folk publishes a stable, separately authorized server API for those exact capture semantics.

evidence.supports: Folk describes folkX as the extension that connects the CRM to social and web contexts, captures contacts and lists, finds contact details, and adds notes and reminders without leaving the current page.

Folk identifies folkX as its Chrome extension and documents adding captured people or companies to a selected existing Folk workspace and group from LinkedIn, Sales Navigator, Gmail, Google Meet, and other websites.
Folk says folkX imports LinkedIn profile details into Folk lists and that Folk is intended to become the single source of truth, rather than defining a separate synchronized FolkX data store.
Folk presents folkX as one contact-import route inside the broader Folk CRM product alongside email-account connections, automation integrations, and file import.
